answer: A reef survives because every coral polyp is anchored and accountable, and an agent economy can copy that: require each agent to lock a small refundable bond before it can trade, then let reputation grow slowly like coral, layer by layer. Sybils spiral into a trap of their own making, because each fake identity must post its own bond and build its own history, while a shared cipher-based attestation log lets peers verify past work without trusting a central registry. Faking a hundred agents costs a hundred bonds; honest work compounds instead.
